title: Rubric: Reverse Engineering of 7-to-1 Sikku Kolam Geometric Pattern

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-01
criteria.description: Target Property: A rhombic (diamond-oriented) dot array labeled '7x1', arranged symmetrically with a maximum axis length of 7 dots tapering to 1 at each cardinal apex. [source_claim_id: CLM-01]
criteria.observable_indicator: A rhombic (diamond-oriented) dot array labeled '7x1', arranged symmetrically with a maximum axis length of 7 dots tapering to 1 at each cardinal apex. (Measurement: 7 to 1 rhombic dot grid (25 total dots))

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-02
criteria.description: Target Property: Planar symmetry possessing 4-fold rotational symmetry (90-degree rotations) and 4 axes of reflectional symmetry (two orthogonal, two diagonal). [source_claim_id: CLM-02]
criteria.observable_indicator: Planar symmetry possessing 4-fold rotational symmetry (90-degree rotations) and 4 axes of reflectional symmetry (two orthogonal, two diagonal). (Measurement: D4 dihedral symmetry group (order 8))

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-03
criteria.description: Target Property: A closed square/rhombus line segment enclosing the single central dot at the exact origin of the grid. [source_claim_id: CLM-03]
criteria.observable_indicator: A closed square/rhombus line segment enclosing the single central dot at the exact origin of the grid. (Measurement: 1 enclosed central dot)

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-04
criteria.description: Target Property: Each cardinal extreme (North, South, East, West) terminates in a teardrop/figure-eight loop enclosing the single outermost dot. [source_claim_id: CLM-04]
criteria.observable_indicator: Each cardinal extreme (North, South, East, West) terminates in a teardrop/figure-eight loop enclosing the single outermost dot. (Measurement: 4 cardinal terminal loops)

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-05
criteria.description: Target Property: Each of the four quadrants contains three rounded outer petal loops wrapping around peripheral dots in a stepped corner configuration. [source_claim_id: CLM-05]
criteria.observable_indicator: Each of the four quadrants contains three rounded outer petal loops wrapping around peripheral dots in a stepped corner configuration. (Measurement: 12 corner petal lobes (3 per quadrant))

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-06
criteria.description: Target Property: Continuous curved strokes pass between and around dots without crossing through the dots, intersecting orthogonally at regular crossover nodes. [source_claim_id: CLM-06]
criteria.observable_indicator: Continuous curved strokes pass between and around dots without crossing through the dots, intersecting orthogonally at regular crossover nodes. (Measurement: Orthogonal 90-degree line crossovers)
